objective: To let VPLD approvers (SH, DpH, DH) approve or reject monthly PRs, one by one or in bulk.
To let a higher level approve directly; lower levels still Pending become Skip.
To create the PO automatically when the PR is approved by DH.

operation.text: 5.1 Access Control

rows: Approve / Reject PR at own level

operation.text: Supplier restriction applies to list, search, totals, detail and download (message no. 3).
5.2 Search Operation
5.2.1 Initial Display
'PR Number' blank, 'Prod. Month From' = Blank, 'Prod. Month To' blank, 'Status' = 'Perlu approval saya' (approver) / 'Pending (all levels)'.
List shows PRs within the user data scope matching the initial criteria, sorted by Production Month then PR Number ascending, 10 rows per page.
5.2.2 Button Operation
User clicks 'Search'.

items: If Prod. Month From > Prod. Month To, display message no. 1. Stop.
Retrieve PRs by PR Number (partial), production month range and Status within the user data scope.
If no data, show 'No Data Found' (message no. 2).

operation.text: User clicks 'Clear': reset all criteria and the list Search box, show all documents within the user data scope.
Key-in on list 'Search' filters immediately. Click a sortable header to sort; click again to reverse.
User clicks 'Kolom': show / hide the checked column groups.
5.3 Detail and Download

User clicks 'PR Number': open 'Detail PR for #<No>' modal with the route detail (10 rows per page, sortable by Route, searchable) and the totals footer: '% Sharing Percentage for <Code>', 'Total QTY', 'Total. Price'.
Route Percentage = route Qty Total / document Total Qty (TBD, OP-09). Price Total = Qty 20 x Price 20 + Qty 40 x Price 40.
Approval History lists every action on the document, latest first.
User clicks 'Download' icon: download CSV '<PR Number>.csv' with header data, every route and a TOTAL row (format TBD, OP-10).
5.4 PR Status

rows: DH Approved (lower levels Approved or Skip); PO created
PO Rejected by GA; PR back to created state, needs resubmit from PR Creation

operation.text: Level status: Pending, Approved, Rejected, Skip, '-' (not reached / cleared). Current PIC is always the PR generator (createdBy).
5.5 Approve / Reject Operation
Rows can be ticked only when the login user is a VPLD approver and their level is Pending on a PR that is not Approved, Rejected or Returned. A higher level does not have to wait for lower levels.
User clicks 'Approve' / 'Reject' (list) or 'Approve' / 'Reject' in Detail PR modal. If no PR is ticked, display message no. 4. Show confirmation modal with the selected PRs.
Approve (submit), per PR:

items: Check role and own level (message no. 7 / 8).
Set own level Approved, Approved By = login user, Approved Date = system date.
Set every lower level that is still Pending to Skip (history note 'X Skip because <Level> approved directly').
If no level is Pending (DH approved): PR Status = Approved and create PO: PO Number = 'PO' + PR Number, Status Pending, Auto Approve At = system date + Day + 1 (System Master).
Insert Approval History; refresh list and display message no. 10.

operation.text: Reject (submit), per PR:

items: If Reason is blank, display message no. 5; if fewer than 10 characters, message no. 6. Stop.
Check role and own level (message no. 7 / 8).
Set own level Rejected with Reason; lower Pending levels -> Skip; higher levels -> '-'. PR Status = Rejected.
Insert Approval History; refresh list and display message no. 10.

operation.text: If one PR in a bulk action fails, the others are still processed; failures are listed in the confirmation modal. Concurrency error: message no. 9.
Database Specification (ELIPS AE070_ILS_DB)

Source of truth for tables / columns / types: docs/db/ELIPS_Schema.sql. No sample data was available: value lists and status codes are TBD. Status: Verified = UISS already matched the schema; Revised = changed to the schema in this revision; Conflict = code / UISS rule not supported by the table; TBD = not confirmed.
Conflicts (UISS / code vs ELIPS schema) - application not changed

items: G-MO-01 PR document: UISS / code: PR Header per trucking company with own PR number. DB: CRITERIA_SCORE_HEADER (period, PR_NO) + CRITERIA_SCORE_DETAIL_FINAL (company, PR_NO_DET). Recommendation: Use PR_NO_DET per company (confirm)
G-MO-02 Approval levels: UISS / code: SH / DpH / DH per PR. DB: CRITERIA_SCORE_APPROVAL.APPROVAL_CLASS + APPROVAL_STS varchar(2). Recommendation: Level codes TBD
G-MO-03 Approval history: UISS / code: History grid with from / to status, role. DB: No history table. Recommendation: Show approval rows or add a history table
G-MO-04 Trucking code: UISS / code: Varchar 3. DB: COMPANY_ID varchar(10). Recommendation: Align with Master Trucking Company
